text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF URINARY TRACT CALCULI
Clinical Features
- Renal and ureteric stones:
- Sudden onset loin pain radiating to the groin
- Haematuria
- Nausea and vomiting
- Stones in the bladder:
- Frequency
- Urgency
- Difficulty in passing urine
- Stones in the urethra
- Urinary retention
